description: This file defines the SessionActions enum which contains static functions for managing session-related operations such as patching, resetting, deleting, compacting sessions, and displaying dialogs for confirmation, errors, and opening session logs in an external editor.

methods.name: patchSession
methods.description: Asynchronously updates parts of a session identified by a key, with optional thinking and verbose levels, by sending a request through ControlChannel.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Asynchronously resets a session identified by a key.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a session identified by a key and its transcript.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Asynchronously compacts a session, limiting it to a maximum number of lines.

methods.name: confirmDestructiveAction
methods.description: Shows a warning alert asking for confirmation of a destructive action, returning true if confirmed.

methods.name: presentError
methods.description: Displays an error alert with a given title and error object.

methods.name: openSessionLogInCode
methods.description: Attempts to open a session log file in VS Code or fall back to revealing the file in Finder.
